SignupCode.Subject: Your IntoChat sign-up code
SignupCode.Title: Confirm your email
SignupCode.Message: Enter this code in IntoChat to finish creating your account.
Features: Never share this code with anyone
SignupCode.IgnoreText: If you didn't try to create an IntoChat account, you can ignore this email.

LoginCode.Subject: Your IntoChat login code
LoginCode.Title: Log in to IntoChat
LoginCode.Message: Enter this code in IntoChat to finish logging in.
Features: Never share this code with anyone
LoginCode.IgnoreText: If you didn't try to log in, change your password. Someone may know it.

ResetCode.Subject: Your IntoChat password reset code
ResetCode.Title: Reset your password
ResetCode.Message: Enter this code in IntoChat to choose a new password.
Features: Never share this code with anyone
ResetCode.IgnoreText: If you didn't ask to reset your password, you can ignore this email. Your password stays the same.

ChangeEmailCode.Subject: Confirm your new IntoChat email
ChangeEmailCode.Title: Confirm your new email
ChangeEmailCode.Message: Enter this code in IntoChat to confirm your new email address.
Features: Never share this code with anyone
ChangeEmailCode.IgnoreText: If you didn't ask to change your email, you can ignore this email.

AccountAlreadyExists.Subject: You already have an IntoChat account
AccountAlreadyExists.Title: You already have an account
AccountAlreadyExists.Message: Someone tried to sign up with this email address, but it already belongs to an IntoChat account.
Features: Log in with your email and password
Forgot your password? Reset it on the login screen
AccountAlreadyExists.IgnoreText: If this wasn't you, you can ignore this email. Your account has not changed.

TeamInvite.Subject: You have been invited to an IntoChat team
TeamInvite.Title: Join your team on IntoChat
TeamInvite.Message: Accept the invite to work in IntoChat together with your team.
Features: Sign in or create an account with this email address to accept
TeamInvite.IgnoreText: If you don't know who sent this, you can ignore this email.

InviteAccepted.Subject: A new member joined your IntoChat team
InviteAccepted.Title: New team member
InviteAccepted.Message: Your invite was accepted. The new member can now work in IntoChat together with your team.
Features: You can see all members of your team in IntoChat
Manage roles and invites from the team settings
InviteAccepted.IgnoreText: You receive this email because you invited this person to your team.

Welcome.Subject: Welcome to IntoChat
Welcome.Title: Welcome to IntoChat
Welcome.Message: Your account is ready. Open IntoChat to start working with your brain.
Features: Your account email is already confirmed
You can change your name and picture on your profile page
Welcome.IgnoreText: You receive this email once, when you create your IntoChat account.
